about: 《中华思想脉络》 v1.0 (a research project built with Codex at Ren's direction), imported for board item ZH. Every file is an archive member byte for byte, one renamed and the CBETA TEI headers as exact byte spans; import_civilization.py --check re-hashes them.

archive.kept_outside: the web page, derived graphs and indexes, the SQLite index, raw responses, lineage snapshots, audits and tools

files.note: the project's maintenance conventions; renamed so that no agent reads them as instructions for this repository
